implement.summary: Round 7 of W03-01 starts from BASE_SHA with the sound r6 history (c1f0723e..7aeb734b) and adds two commits: 7691d8cb (tests) and da6ff3c7 (fix). Defects on the r6 candidate (42bf4c60), all VERIFIED by the new tests failing there (19 failures, artifacts/w03-01-r7/ac2-r6.log) and passing on HEAD: (A1) apps/mobile/src/camera/importAdmission.ts groupPeaks() treated any inter-peak dip smaller than minPeakProminenceTorsoPerSecond as jitter, so four 450 ms volleys with valleys at 64-75 % of their peaks fused into one admitted 1.85 s stroke; (A2) isStrokePhase() folded a burst that is stroke-sized on its own (>= minStrokePeakTorsoPerSecond) into a harder neighbour as wind-up/recovery whenever it was <= 0.5 of the stroke peak, so adding a harder burst turned a refused two-stroke clip into an admitted one; (A3) admitImportedStrokeEvents() evaluated touchesSeriesStart/End on the cluster core only, so a folded wind-up/recovery cut by the clip edge or by a tracking gap was ignored; (A4) a right-wrist landmark hole (body tracked, wrist not) up to maxUntrackedSpanMs hid a second stroke and the lone visible stroke was admitted. On the shipping path (apps/mobile/src/analysis/runCaptureAnalysis.ts) each of these reached POST /v1/analysis-permits, inference and a rated-shot write. Fix (importAdmission.ts only): (1) jitter grouping additionally requires the valley to stay above maxSharedValleyRatio (0.8) of the lesser peak; (2) a lead event whose smoothed speed stays within that ratio of its peak for more than maxNearPeakMs (600 ms) is refused as motion_not_stroke_like (rallies whose valleys never leave the plateau); (3) a stroke-sized phase folds only as a wind-up handing off into the swing within maxStrokePhaseHandoffMs (100 ms), never as a recovery (admission is monotonic; a hard drive's direct backswing still folds — the existing drive/dink/fps control suites all pass); (4) clip-edge truncation is judged on the whole folded movement: a phase touching the first/last tracked sample or a gap while still >= 0.8 of its own peak speed refuses with stroke_truncated_at_clip_edge, a phase that decayed to rest at the edge does not; (5) the hitting wrist must be tracked on every pose frame between its first and last measurement — a wrist-only hole > maxSampleGapMs (150 ms) refuses with wrist_not_tracked; whole-pose gaps remain bounded by the existing coverage gate (maxUntrackedSpanMs). runCaptureAnalysis.ts is unchanged in r7 (its r6 wiring already refuses via admitImportedMedia/admitImportedClip before the permit, inference and any durable row; the new S1-S3 tests pin this on both the session-less and saved-original paths: permitReservations=0, inferenceRuns=0, ratedShotWrites=0, durableRows=0, fetch never called). Temporary attack/scratch test files were deleted before commit. No PR opened; no force-push.

implement.approach: Start at BASE_SHA on devin/pp/w03-01/impl-r8, cherry-pick the r5-r7 admission history (sound; the r7 breaks are all inside importAdmission.ts's event grouping and coverage rules), write r8 regression tests for every adversary break plus controls and commit them separately (prove they fail on r7: 29/181), then fix the rules generally: jitter fold measured against the event's highest peak and bounded to 10 % rise; contact dip must retain 80 % of the lesser peak; every unobserved stretch of the clip (interior whole-pose gap, clip lead-in/tail, hitting-wrist interior/edge holes) bounded by the shortest stroke motion core (150 ms) instead of 2500 ms. Shipping wiring in runCaptureAnalysis.ts (r7, unchanged) already places both admissions before extraction, sealObservation and permit reservation, so refusals never create a journal row, permit, inference run or durable row.

residual_risks: Codec / rotation / video-track-layout admission (admitImportedMedia's ImportedMediaProbe) is NOT fed real facts on the shipping path: CapturedClip (apps/mobile/src/camera/capture.ts) and the pose sidecar `video` block carry only duration/fps/width/height, so runCaptureAnalysis.ts:843 calls admitImportedMedia(clip) with an empty probe and those three checks are unreachable in shipping (adversary ATTACK 10, not among the judged breaks). INFERRED from apps/mobile/ios/LocalPods/PickleNative/Sources/ClipMediaStore.swift preflightImport: the native importer already refuses assets that are not playable / protected, with != 1 enabled video track, non-finite preferredTransform, or non-video format descriptions, and applies preferredTransform to width/height — so track layout and rotation are enforced natively and undecodable codecs fail isPlayable; but an unsupported-yet-decodable codec is not refused with a precise JS reason. Closing this requires the bridge payload (native-pod serial group, not held by this package) and CapturedClip to carry codec/rotation/trackCount — flagged for a follow-up package rather than fabricated here.

Limits are tuned against generated fixtures (@pickle/evaluation generateSwingSequence + the hand-built rally/gap shapes): maxJitterRiseRatio=0.1, eventValleyRatio=0.8, maxUnobservedSpanMs=150 make admission conservative — real imports whose Vision tracking drops the whole pose or the hitting wrist for >150 ms anywhere, or that start/end >150 ms before/after the first/last tracked frame, are refused (pose_coverage_incomplete / wrist_not_tracked). This is the intended conservative direction (ambiguous -> refuse, never charge) but may raise the refusal rate on real footage; no real-device evidence in this round (UNKNOWN).

The adversary suites (w03ImportAdmissionAttack*.test.ts from 853b3114) were run locally only and not added to the branch (outside write_paths); two of their control fixtures keep a 200 ms unobserved tail and now report pose_coverage_incomplete rather than the reason those fixtures anticipated.
implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA 5c1859a8: apps/mobile/src/camera/importAdmission.ts does not exist and apps/mobile/src/analysis/runCaptureAnalysis.ts runs every imported clip straight into sealObservation/admit/permit reservation (BASE runCaptureAnalysis.ts ~L838-900 had no admission step), so the two acceptance suites cannot even load there (AC2 base log). Round 8 starts from BASE, replays the sound r5-r7 history (commits c1f0723e..da6ff3c7: admission module + shipping wiring at runCaptureAnalysis.ts:842-845 media admission before extraction and :894-901 full clip admission before sealObservation/permit), then closes the six r7 adversary breaks. Regression tests first (23f34de6, then the expectation/fixture follow-up 5952d006), implementation last (806d511b). Root causes fixed in importAdmission.ts: (1)+(2) groupPeaks folded a following peak as 'jitter' whenever the valley kept >=80 % of the LESSER peak, so a 10 %/volley decaying or rising rally chained itself pairwise, and any two peaks within sameEventPeakDistanceMs (350 ms) merged short of a dead stop — now a peak is jitter only when it rises out of its valley by <= maxJitterRiseRatio (10 %) of the EVENT'S HIGHEST peak, and a contact dip must keep eventValleyRatio (80 %) of the lesser peak; equal-peak 330 ms volleys with a 55 % valley and hard/soft 330 ms volleys with a 45 % valley are now multiple_stroke_events, while genuine single strokes with a shallow contact wobble (existing drive/dink fixtures) still admit. (3) The only whole-pose gap check was the 2500 ms maxUntrackedSpanMs — new unobservedPoseGap() refuses any interior stretch with no tracked pose longer than maxUnobservedSpanMs (150 ms = the shortest stroke motion core), reason pose_coverage_incomplete with the exact gap in the detail. (4) wristTrackingHole() only looked between the lead wrist's first and last measurement — new wristEdgeHole() also measures the untracked lead-in before its first and tail after its last measurement against the same bound, reason wrist_not_tracked; a hole in the NON-hitting wrist does not refuse (control pinned). (5) Sidecar lead-in/tail was bounded only by maxUntrackedSpanMs — unobservedEdgeMs() now bounds the unobserved clip edges by maxUnobservedSpanMs (2.4 s and 400 ms lead-ins refused as pose_coverage_incomplete; a 100 ms lead-in still admits). (6) Shipping path: because admitImportedClip runs at runCaptureAnalysis.ts:897 before sealObservation (:902) and permit admission (:912), every newly refused shape returns importRefusedOutcome (quality_blocked with the precise reason) with permitReservations=0, permitFinalizations=0, inferenceRuns=0, ratedShotWrites=0, durableRows=0 — pinned for all five ATTACK-9 shapes in importedCaptureAnalysis.test.ts. Check ordering: multiple comparable events -> motion span / clip-edge truncation -> whole-pose gap -> hitting-wrist interior/edge hole, so existing reason expectations hold. Adversary suites from 853b3114 were run locally against the candidate (not committed, outside write_paths): ATTACK 1-4, 8 and 9 all refuse; the only remaining adversary failures were two fixtures whose imported duration leaves a 200 ms unobserved tail (now refused as pose_coverage_incomplete — the stricter rule firing on the fixture, not an admission) and ATTACK 10 (see residual_risks). No PR opened; no push to main/ci/mac-*; no --remote Mac run; no production Supabase, secrets, or release actions touched.
